entities.name: Miri
entities.description: A human Orzhov tithe taker on Ravnica who joins the Selesnyan Conclave.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild in which Miri spends time.

entities.name: Danika
entities.description: Miri's podmate who showed her kindness.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The great tree where Miri found a vulnerable spot.

events.summary: Miri subdued a citizen who refused the new 30% tithing rate.
events.quote: a citizen resisted the new 30% tithing rate and made threats, leading her to subdue him forcefully

events.summary: Miri took a spy's Selesnyan robes after witnessing his punishment; her father caught her wearing them.
events.quote: Miri witnessed the brutal punishment of a spy and impulsively took the spy's Selesnyan robes

events.summary: Danika swapped plants with Miri so she could succeed at the growth spell.
events.quote: Danika's selfless act of swapping their plants

events.summary: Miri discovered a vulnerable spot in Vitu-Ghazi but chose honesty and gave her father an artifact from her mother.
events.quote: Miri chose honesty and presented her father with a valuable artifact gifted by her mother

relations.quote: Miri is a human tithe taker, part of the Orzhov Syndicate on the plane of Ravnica
especially Danika, who showed her kindness and solidarity
